Part of [C10: Lipid modifying agents](../).

C10A covers the single-agent lipid modifiers, as opposed to the fixed combinations in C10B.
Its chemical subgroups are the [statins](c10aa/) (C10AA), fibrates (C10AB), bile acid sequestrants (C10AC), nicotinic acid and derivatives (C10AD), and others (C10AX).
